values.note: Single site $22 a night. Day use/boat launch $5/vehicle/day or $30/season, not charged to paying campers.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night'; 'Day use/boat launch - $5/vehicle/day or $30/vehicle/season'; 'Day use fees will not be charged to those who have already paid for a campground campsite.'), read 2026-10-25

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('Golden Age/Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Single loop of 21 spacious sites 'that can accommodate tents, trailers or larger motor homes' (19 for campers, sites 15 and 16 walk-in tent sites), each with a parking spur. Sites 1-6 have horse corrals. Eight people, two motorized vehicles and one RV or camper trailer per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('a single loop with 21 spacious sites that can accommodate tents, trailers or larger motor homes. Each site offers wooden picnic table, fire ring, lantern post and parking spur'; 'No. of Sites: 21 (19 for campers and two walk-in-only sites)'; 'Sites 1-6 accommodate equestrian camping'; 'Eight people and 2 motorized vehicles are allowed per campsite with a maximum of one RV or camper trailer'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One accessible and three single vault toilets; two pressurized water faucets in the loop (no water or garbage service after October 15).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('1 Accessible Vault Toilet and 3 Single Vault Toilets in campground'; 'Potable water is available at this site. Pressurized faucets'; 'Reduced services begin on October 15, 2026. No garbage service or water will be provided.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: First-come, first-served; no recreation.gov listing. Concessionaire-run: Camp Host, LLC, (906) 661-8870. Campers must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('No reservations; first come, first served.'; 'Camping in a developed recreation site is allowed for a period not longer than 14 days'; 'Contact Name: Camp Host, LLC Contact Phone: (906) 661-8870') + recreation.gov search for 'Courtney Lake' (no campground facility returned), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Full services (water, garbage) from the Friday before Memorial Day to October 15 (FS 'Seasons of Use May 15 - October 15'); the campground stays open year-round with reduced services, and winter access can be limited by snow plowing.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/ottawa/recreation/courtney-lake-campground ('The day use area, boat launch and campground are open year-round; however, services are reduced, and winter access can be limited due to snow plowing.'; 'scheduled to open with full services the Friday before Memorial Day'; 'Seasons of Use May 15 – October 15'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground on 33-acre Courtney Lake, 22 mi southeast of Ontonagon off M-38 (1 mi south on FR 1960), Ontonagon Ranger District; a scenic lake view from the loop. Sites 1-6 are equestrian sites with corrals - the Courtney Lake trails here are the only equestrian system on the Ottawa, groomed for cross-country skiing in winter. Boat landing, picnic area and trailhead parking adjacent. --Claude
summary: FS page: 21 sites (confirmed; 19 drive-in that take trailers or larger motor homes, 2 walk-in tent), $22 (confirmed), passes accepted (new), vault toilets + pressurized water (confirmed), first-come only (confirmed; recreation.gov search finds no listing), 14-day limit (new), open year-round with full services Memorial Day weekend - Oct 15 (new). Concessionaire-run (Camp Host, LLC) on Forest Service land; ownership federal kept. Only Ottawa alert nearby was a past rally road closure (Oct 9-10, 2026, near Kenton); nothing on M-38/FR 1960. Phone missing (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements.
